title: asq Office 1.4 request bodies
description: The validated request bodies of the changed contract-revision-1.4 mutations (backend-v1.4.md §4, §5). Every one of these routes requires the X-Office-Contract: 1.4 handshake and an Idempotency-Key header, and rejects a v1.3-shaped call with 409 contract_revision_required BEFORE any side effect. Requests are strict: an undocumented property is rejected rather than ignored, because a security or semantic invariant must never be inferred from an unknown field. The fields a request MAY carry and the back-end ignores are listed explicitly in backend-v1.4.md §5. This file has no root body; each route names a $defs pointer.

PromptId.description: The prompt_id the client read from the Question it is answering (snapshot.json#/$defs/Question). It fences the answer to one observed prompt lifecycle: if the pane moved on, the back-end refuses with 409 stale_prompt and sends zero keystrokes.

IdempotencyKey.description: Documented here for one definition, but carried as the Idempotency-Key HEADER, never in a body. Uniqueness is reserved on (local auth-session scope, key). The compared fingerprint is operation kind + resolved target + validated body; deliberately NOT the uniqueness key, so reusing one key for a different kind or target is detected as 409 idempotency_conflict instead of quietly succeeding.

ResolveRequest.title: ResolveRequest

option.description: One of question.options[].key, for kind permission | plan | continue. The back-end owns the keystroke plan for that option and echoes it in receipt.keys.

reason.description: For the deny path: typed into the "tell Claude what to do differently" field.

selections.description: kind ask: selections[i] holds the chosen option indexes of tab i, in the tabs' on-screen order.

other.description: kind ask: free text for the auto-added "Other" choice, keyed by the tab index as a decimal string ("0", "1", …). The validator cannot constrain key shape, so the back-end rejects a key that is not a decimal index within range with 400 invalid.

text.description: kind question | note: the literal text to type, sent as a bracketed paste followed by Enter.

confirm.description: Required true when the chosen option would switch the agent into auto or bypass mode; without it the back-end answers 409 mode_change and sends nothing (§5).

ResolveRequest.description: POST /api/queue/{id}/resolve at revision 1.4. This is the ONE normative structured resolve body. The v1 {answer} body is historical: backend-v1.4.md §7 records it, and a 1.4 call carrying it is 409 contract_revision_required, not a second interpretation.

kind.description: Bulk answering is permission-only. A plan changes the agent's mode and an ask has tabs; neither may be swept.

option.description: Never allow-remember: a bulk action must not leave a durable rule behind.

prompt_ids.description: Exactly the prompts the client saw. Any id that is no longer the agent's current prompt is skipped and reported, and the rest still proceed; the back-end never widens the sweep to a prompt the client did not name.

keys.description: tmux key names (Enter, Escape, Up, C-c, BTab…). The server resolves which pane they reach from the agent id; the browser never names a pane or a tmux target.

hard.description: Absent or false: the supported soft interrupt, Escape — Claude keeps the work and asks what to do instead. true: C-c, which ends the current tool or turn. One operation, two explicit strengths (§4).
